Olivia (CSM): Heads-up — Lyra preview cohort showing drop-off after seat invite. Activation rate ~22% after 7 days. Flagging as potential renewal-risk if we don't boost engagement.
Jamal (AM): yikes. Is that across all orgs or just Lyra customers?
Olivia (CSM): Narrowed to lyra-preview group: lyra-inc + lyra-data. Two patterns: SSO invite failures and confusion on quickstart docs.
Deploy Bot: event: user.sso_failed user=ben@lyra.com org=lyra-inc time=2025-11-03T14:12:02Z
Deploy Bot: Notice: 3 sso_failure events for lyra-inc in last 24h
Sophia (Enablement): I can run a 25-min 1:1 quickstart next week. Available slots (PST): Mon 10:00-11:00, Tue 14:00-15:00, Wed 09:00-09:30. Which works for Ben?
Olivia (CSM): Can you tailor the session to their chat workload — emphasize prefix/KV caching, batching config, and quick token-cost monitoring tips.
Sophia (Enablement): Yep. I'll prepare a 1-page TL;DR + a short live demo. Draft link (internal): https://go.redwood/enablement/lyra-quickstart
Ben (Customer: Lyra): Thanks. I clicked the invite link and got a 403. Screenshot attached in DM.
Olivia (CSM): Ben — can you confirm org admin email and whether you're on Okta or AzureAD?
Ben (Customer: Lyra): Okta. Admin is admin@lyra.com. Screenshot posted (DM).
Olivia (CSM): Got it. Jamal — can you reissue invites and check token path? Quick command in runbook: `tools/invite-retry --org lyra-inc --force`
Jamal (AM): On it. I've pinged #eng-oncall with summary so we have a ticket.
eng-oncall: @jamal_csm ticket created -> INC-4521: lyra-inc SSO invite 403 (assigned to eng-sso)
Olivia (CSM): Also sending a 90-second pulse to Lyra admins to capture friction points: Survey Bot link below — please ask Ben to fill it out when convenient.
Survey Bot: Lyra preview pulse: https://survey.redwood/lyra-preview-1 — estimated time 2 mins.
Olivia (CSM): Action items: 1) Jamal -> ensure INC-4521 tracks invite reissue + escalate if repeats. 2) Sophia -> run 1:1 quickstart (prepare caching/batching examples) — target Tue 14. 3) Ben -> fill the pulse + confirm Tue slot. 4) I'll follow up in 72h and update renewal-risk tag if no improvement.
Ben (Customer: Lyra): Confirmed — Tue 14:00 PST works for me.
Olivia (CSM): Sweet. Marking thread as watch for renewal-risk. :eyes:
Jamal (AM): Noted. I'll close the loop after quickstart + survey results.
Sophia (Enablement): I'll share the quickstart slide deck and a short post-session checklist in this thread after the session.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks team — will update INC-4521 with notes and next check-in on Fri. :thumbsup:
